review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion and warehouse connector behavior
review.reason: The observed changes are localized corrections to error messages and assertions within warehouse-related serialization and response handling. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 modify exception messages raised when a warehouse table or view name conflict occurs, while P1.F2.H2 updates the response body message. These changes improve the clarity of failure communication for warehouse users, a 'n
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to message clarity; no changes to execution, recovery, or systemic reliability are demonstrated. The tier is assigned based on the localized, bounded nature of the change rather than broader capability or risk reduction.

observations.limitations: This chunk only shows a change to error messages and their corresponding assertions. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: The error message raised when a table or view with the same name already exists is updated.
observations.code_quote: raise serializers.ValidationError("A table or view with this name already exists. Choose a different name.")
observations.posthog_connection: This could help warehouse users distinguish between tables and views when they encounter a naming conflict, potentially reducing support requests or confusion.
